legacy_payload.best_for: 以双色油墨加藏青中性的孔版印刷语言、半调网点与硬偏移阴影表达独立出版 zine 的个性与温度
legacy_payload.visual_direction: two-color risograph halftone print, navy and fluorescent pink on cream paper, grain and slight misregistration, offset-shadow sticker cards and numerals, bold flat illustration, mono chrome eyebrows and footers, indie print zine mood, no text

canvas.composition: offset-shadow sticker cards / numbers / headlines, mono chrome margins

color_palette.primary: navy ink #1B2A4A as the neutral text ink
color_palette.secondary: fluorescent pink #FF4D8D, process yellow #F5B301 (the 2 riso inks)
color_palette.rule: hold to the 2 inks + navy neutral — no extra hues; shadows are HARD offsets, never soft

typography.title: bold poster sans (Arial Black / 思源黑体 Black), sticker-cut feel
typography.body: clean sans (Arial / 思源黑体), navy ink
typography.labels: mono chrome for eyebrows / footers / page markers (Consolas / 等宽)
typography.text_quality: ink-on-paper crisp, high contrast on cream

layout_patterns: sticker card: content card with a hard offset duplicate behind it in one ink
big numeral sticker: oversized riso numeral with offset shadow as section marker
full-bleed duotone halftone illustration plate + caption in mono chrome
cover = cream ground + duotone halftone hero + offset-shadow display title
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Two inks plus navy only; every shadow is a hard offset; halftone illustrations carry the personality.
negative_prompt: no soft shadows or drop-shadow blur — offsets are hard duplicates
no third accent hue beyond pink / yellow / navy
no glossy screen-style surfaces or glass panels

visual_elements.allowed: halftone duotone plates, offset-shadow stickers, mono chrome rules, grain and misregistration
visual_elements.avoid: soft shadows, gradients, extra hues, photographic realism

rendering_constraints: Two-ink riso print look with grain and slight misregistration.
Offset shadows are hard-edged duplicates, never blurred.
